question: Which footstool-endowed practitioner is described as possessed of the holy intelligence footstool belonging to the śāmbhavī-named footstool?
premises: śāmbhavī-named footstool appears in genitive case
practitioner is described as endowed with holy intelligence footstool
endowment connects the two named footstools
inference: The described subject possesses the śrīmedhā footstool associated with the śāmbhavī-named footstool.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of pādukā remains unclear
plain_english: He is endowed with the holy intelligence footstool of the footstool called Śāmbhavī.
